paragraphs.text: Mm'menon is an Illvoi and a former member of the Uthros Combine in the Sothera system of the Edge . They acted as a liaison for Tezzeret while he was in the Edge.

Mm'menon is an enormous jellyfish crowned by a translucent brain-mantle. They wear fine, sheer silks and a mask at an arbitrary point on the edge of its brain-mantle. They smell lightly of swamp and heavily of cologne. They are an adept cloudsculptor, a polyglot, and a constant presence at Tezzeret's side.
Mm'menon pilots a cloudsculpted boreaship crewed by Illvoi cloudsculptors and engineering mechans. The ship is a photoreactive sphere of superfluid helium, two degrees above absolute zero .

Mm'menon was a member of the Uthros Combine until the Endstone caused their head to be filled with omens. After they deduced the presence of a causality manipulator in Sothera from surveys of systemwide data, they pestered the Combine about the potential artifact so much that they were permanently exiled. After being expelled, Mm'menon lent their services to the planeswalker Tezzeret to stay in-system, hoping to solve the mystery of Uthros and capitalize on it.
